VLM keeps following the music when you start casting.

- Starting or stopping a cast changes where Android sends the sound, which silently stopped NUONDroid's audio. VLM then stopped hearing the music. NUONDroid now notices and reconnects right away. This also fixes your own music files (and game sound) going quiet after plugging in headphones, HDMI or a TV.
- Spotify and other apps: VLM now hears the music straight from the capture, not through NUONDroid's own (silent) audio output, so it no longer depends on it at all.
- Android allows only one screen capture at a time, so starting a Chromecast cast ends NUONDroid's sound capture. It now switches to Android's Visualizer straight away instead of waiting.
